texts.li: {A_nameDef} took {B_nameDef} down to the pens and showed {B_objective} how to come up on an animal slow, from the side, talking all the while. {B_nameDef} has been practising on everything since, including the cook.
{B_nameDef} spent the afternoon at {A_nameDef}'s heels, carrying the feed bucket and asking questions. By evening {B_nameDef} knew every animal's name and three of their bad habits.
{A_nameDef} let {B_nameDef} hold the lead rope for the first time. {B_nameDef} held it the whole way to the pens with both hands and didn't breathe.

Half the herd got out through a gap in the fence, and {B_nameDef} dropped what {B_pronoun} was doing to help {A_nameDef} bring them back. It took an hour and a great deal of shouting, and they were both laughing by the end.
{B_nameDef} helped {A_nameDef} with the evening feed when {A_nameDef}'s hands were full, and stayed to learn which animal gets fed first, and why.
{A_nameDef} needed someone to hold a nervous animal still while {A_pronoun} saw to its hoof. {B_nameDef} did it, came out muddy, and was thanked properly.
